headline: GPT-5.5 lands as Meta cuts 8,000 jobs for AI
body: A heavy news day. OpenAI released GPT-5.5, an agent-focused model that it rates High risk for biological and cyber capability. That raises both Capability Velocity and AI Autonomy, lifting endings that need powerful, independent AI: Descendants, Zookeeper, Protector God and Conquerors. Meta confirmed about 8,000 layoffs, roughly 10%, starting May 20 to fund its AI build-out. That cuts into Shared Prosperity and pulls Egalitarian Utopia down. Tennessee's new law declaring that AI cannot be a legal person draws a firmer line between humans and machines, weakening Human–AI Merging and trimming Descendants. Tencent's open Hy3 model was a small counterweight to power concentration. Horizon Balance slipped to +1.77, down 0.17, and two endings swapped places.
movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia -0.5 came from Meta's layoffs (-0.56). Zookeeper +0.5, Protector God +0.5 and Conquerors +0.5 were driven by the GPT-5.5 release (+0.56, +0.52 and +0.52).
